sbar.situation: The bank has recovered after three faults; the single recovery check at 21 s ran the payment journey cleanly. Payments, gateway and clearing are working again.
sbar.background: The reconciliation session held a write lock on the ledger for 10.5 s, so payments failed with 'ledger busy'. The clearing worker crashed on malformed queue item 90 (JSONDecodeError), and the scheduler raised the gateway balance_cache_ttl_s from 0.5 s to 600 s.
sbar.assessment: The incident commander ended the reconciliation session holding the ledger lock, and payments can write again. It reverted gateway balance_cache_ttl_s from 600 s back to 0.5 s, so balances will not show stale. It set aside clearing item 90 and restarted clearing, which is now running.
sbar.recommendation: Recovery was confirmed by only one look, so watch payments, ledger locks and clearing for a while, and find out why the scheduler changed balance_cache_ttl_s and why reconciliation held the lock so long. The operations team has been asked (soon priority) to review clearing item 90 and either repair and resubmit it or close it with its customer. That payment has not cleared until they do.
